lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p35 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, point and say connects geometric terms to real-world objects. Students listen to the audio and identify the sphere (orange), cylinder (can), and cone (ice cream).
Look for correct pointing to the specific food items when the shape name is called out and clear repetition of "sphere," "cylinder," and "cone."

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p35 - Look at the pattern and say. Then draw.

details: Look and draw develops logical sequencing. Students analyse the pattern of shapes (sphere, sphere, cylinder, cone, cone...) to determine what comes next and draw it in the box.
Look for correct identification of the pattern rule and drawing the right shapes next to the blue cylinder in the box.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p70 - Trace the shapes.

details: Trace develops fine motor control and shape formation. Students trace the dashed lines of the sphere, cylinder, and cone to understand their 3D representation on paper.
Look for careful pencil control following the curves and straight lines of the 3D shapes.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p70 - Read and tick What's next?

details: Read and tick assesses pattern recognition. Students look at the sequence of food items and tick the box for the item that should come next in the logical order.
Look for correct ticking of the empty box next to the matching shape (e.g., ticking the cone after the pattern implies a cone).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p97 - Add or take away. Match.

details: Add or take away combines arithmetic with shape recognition. Students solve the sums inside the shapes (e.g., 14+2) and draw a line to the correct answer.
Look for correct calculation (16, 27, 33, 40, 36) and accurate lines connecting the sums to the answers on the right.
